source_text: Sicut in novissimis diebus Verbum Dei ex Maria carne vestitum processit — aliud quod videbatur, aliud quod intelligebatur — ita cum per prophetas vel legislatorem Verbum profertur, litterae velamine tegitur. Levitici ritus et hostiae littera tamquam caro sunt; spiritalis sensus tamquam divinitas. Beati oculi qui velamine litterae obtectum Spiritum vident. Sequentes solam historiam ad vitulos et agnos offerendos coguntur; ecclesia Susannae vocibus utitur: melius est in manus vestras incidere quam peccare in Domino. Conversis ad Dominum aufertur velamen; ubi Spiritus Domini, ibi libertas. Revela oculos meos, et considerabo mirabilia de lege tua.
pass_a_gloss: Just-as in last days Word of-God from Mary with-flesh clothed went-forth — other what was-seen, other what was-understood — so when through prophets or lawgiver Word is-brought-forth, with-letter veil it-is-covered. Of-Leviticus rites and victims letter as flesh are; spiritual sense as divinity. Blessed eyes which with-veil of-letter covered Spirit see. Following only history to calves and lambs to-be-offered are-compelled; church with-Susanna voices uses: better is into hands your to-fall than to-sin against Lord. To-ones-turned to Lord is-taken-away veil; where Spirit of-Lord, there freedom. Uncover eyes my, and I-will-consider wonders from law your.
pass_b_english: [[Just as in the last days >> Bible:Hebrews 1:2]] the Word of God came forth from Mary clothed in flesh — one thing seen, another understood — so when the Word speaks through the prophets or the lawgiver it wears the veil of the letter. Leviticus’s rites and victims are letter like flesh; the spiritual sense is divinity within. Blessed are the eyes that see the Spirit under that veil. Those who cling to bare history are driven to offer calves and lambs; the church answers with Susanna: [[better to fall into your hands than to sin against the Lord >> Bible:Daniel 13:22-23]]. [[When one turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away; where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom >> Bible:2 Corinthians 3:16-17]]. [[Open my eyes, and I will behold wonders from your law >> Bible:Psalm 119:18]].
